faq1_a: No. WealthX is a structured personal finance system for accounts, assets and liabilities, multiple currencies, budgets, Scenarios, transactions, Flows, goals, investments, search, insights, maps, widgets, and data control.
faq1_q: Is WealthX only a budget tracker?
faq2_a: Smart Flows use recent activity and spending frequency to show Flows you may need. You choose a Flow, enter the amount, and confirm the record.
faq3_a: No. It analyzes historical transactions and current budgets to suggest an amount or time-frame change. Every suggestion is reviewable and applies only after you confirm.
faq3_q: Does Smart Budget change my budget automatically?
faq4_a: No. Scenarios express everyday life, travel, family, and project contexts through budgets. They do not create a direct Scenario-to-Account relationship.
faq4_q: Do Scenarios connect directly to Accounts?
faq5_a: Split Bill allocates one actual payment across multiple budgets. Repayments, reimbursements, and full or partial refunds can stay linked to the original transaction. This is not collaboration or automated settlement.
faq5_q: What can Split Bill and refund records represent?
faq6_a: No. WealthX can track investment accounts, holdings, trades, deposits, withdrawals, buys, sells, and market value for records and context only.
faq7_a: Cashflow Calendar and Spending Heatmap widgets are available to Free users, alongside basic views. Availability of other views and features depends on access.
faq8_a: Yes. WealthX provides search across key record types and currently supported import, export, and backup paths. Depending on platform and settings, records remain on your device or in your private iCloud database.
faq8_q: Can I search, import, export, and back up my records?
feature_budget_body: Smart Budget analyzes historical transactions and current budgets, then suggests a future category amount or time frame that may make progress more meaningful and measurable.
feature_budget_point1: Review every suggestion before anything changes.
feature_budget_point2: Plan by month, quarter, year, or project.
feature_budget_point3: Raise, lower, or reshape a future budget only when it fits.

feature_data_body: Search across the system, use currently supported import, export, and backup paths, and keep a portable copy when you need one.

privacy_sec1_body: WealthX works with personal finance records that you create or import, including accounts, transactions, budgets, scenarios, Flows, investments, goals, chart settings, icons, and related notes.
privacy_sec1_item1: Finance records are stored on your device or in your private iCloud/CloudKit database. They are not uploaded to the WealthX account and subscription service.
privacy_sec1_item2: Location is optional and is used for Cashflow Map only when you grant permission.
privacy_sec1_item3: Custom images, emoji, and system symbols are used for personalization only when you choose them.
privacy_sec1_item4: On iOS, you can choose whether to enable iCloud sync. On macOS, WealthX Pro requires an available iCloud account and keeps CloudKit sync enabled while the workspace is unlocked.
privacy_sec2_body: To verify WealthX Pro access and support entitlements across supported platforms, WealthX processes limited account and subscription metadata.
privacy_sec2_item1: Account metadata may include an internal WealthX user ID, an Apple-verified App Transaction identifier, a SHA-256 one-way digest derived from the current CloudKit user record identifier, an app account token, a hashed session token, platform, and verification timestamps.
privacy_sec2_item2: Subscription metadata may include Apple or Stripe purchase and subscription identifiers, product, plan, status, expiry, trial state, verification timestamps, and a Stripe customer identifier when Stripe applies.
privacy_sec2_item3: The raw CloudKit user record identifier and signed App Transaction are processed to verify the account but are not retained in raw form.
privacy_sec2_item4: WealthX does not receive payment-card or bank-account details entered with Apple or Stripe.
privacy_sec3_body: Account and subscription metadata is used only to authenticate sessions, verify or restore Pro access across supported platforms, prevent conflicting account claims, maintain entitlement status, provide account support, and carry out account deletion. WealthX does not use this information for advertising or tracking.
privacy_sec4_body: Apple provides App Store, StoreKit, and iCloud/CloudKit services. Stripe processes Stripe subscriptions when applicable. Render hosts the WealthX account and subscription service and may process network request metadata. We do not sell personal finance data or account metadata. Information is disclosed only as needed to operate these services, when required by law, to protect rights and safety, or at your request.
privacy_sec5_body: Finance records remain on your device or in your private iCloud database. WealthX limits the account and subscription metadata it stores, and hashes tokens or encrypts credentials where appropriate. This metadata is retained while your WealthX account exists or as reasonably needed to operate and secure the service, meet legal obligations, or resolve disputes. No digital system should be treated as risk-free.
privacy_sec6_body: You control import and export workflows. Locking WealthX hides finance data and stops app access to CloudKit, but does not delete the underlying records. After a confirmed WealthX account deletion succeeds, WealthX removes the server-side account, sessions, entitlement records, App Transaction/CloudKit binding, applicable legacy installation mapping, and pending Stripe Checkout state.
privacy_sec6_item1: Deleting a WealthX account does not cancel an Apple or Stripe subscription. Manage or cancel each subscription through its billing provider.
privacy_sec6_item2: Local and private-iCloud finance records remain after account deletion. You can manage or remove them separately in WealthX or through Apple platform settings where applicable.
privacy_sec6_item3: Files you export are external copies under your control. Locking or deleting WealthX does not remove those files.
privacy_sec7_body: WealthX is not intended for children below the age required by local law to manage personal finance records without appropriate consent.
privacy_subtitle: Your finance records remain under your control; WealthX services process only the limited account and subscription metadata needed to verify access.
